meta.title: Exit-Readiness Checklist — Yonkers Brewing Company LLC
meta.source: Chart of Accounts Review, July 26, 2026 (live QuickBooks Online data)
meta.lens: Every finding scored the way a PE buyer's quality-of-earnings team would see it. Goal: books that survive diligence and support the highest defensible multiple.

findings.finding: Total equity negative (−$12,929); ~24 individual member accounts, several large negatives (John Rubbo Equity −$476,754); paired 'Name'/'Name Equity' accounts double the clutter; misspellings ('Equiry', 'Felecia', 'Laura Tenebaum' under 'David Tenebaum').
findings.fix: Reconcile member equity to a clean cap table and the operating agreement; consolidate paired accounts; fix names.

findings.finding: Petty Cash carries $42,702 — far beyond any real till float. Almost always uncleared cash or misclassification.
findings.fix: Investigate underlying entries and reclassify; get petty cash to a true small float.

findings.finding: AP shows a debit balance of −$60,891 — vendor prepayments, credits, or misapplied payments in the wrong direction.
findings.fix: Clean up and reclassify prepayments to an asset.

findings.finding: Loan – John $62,053; Intercompany 'Chicken Island' account; large owner equity swings.
findings.fix: Document terms for every related-party balance; settle or formalize before sale. Feed into the normalized-EBITDA add-back log.

findings.finding: '4150 Sales', '4140 Other Sales', '4220 Other Sales' coexist; 'Sales of Product Income' leaks $87. Same problem on Toast side ($4,222 uncategorized Margarita, duplicate beer buttons).
findings.fix: Retire catch-alls; map every Toast item to a real GL category. One taxonomy, Toast-to-GL, enforced (see toast_qbo_map.json).

findings.finding: GL cannot tell bar from dining from patio from stage; live-music revenue (9101) has no matching departmental cost grouping.
findings.fix: Add QuickBooks classes/locations for revenue centers and tag transactions (see revenue_centers in toast_qbo_map.json).
Reconcile tips and payroll clearing each pay cycle; labor skill enforces cash-tip capture upstream.

findings.finding: NY Excise Tax balance $0.01 — effectively unused — despite active wholesale and internal beer movement.
findings.fix: Stand up a real excise accrual (federal TTB and NY) so the liability books as it accrues.

findings.finding: P&L summary returned net income $0 / expenses $0 while detail shows ~$123K operating income and $737K expenses.
findings.fix: Resolve the account-type/mapping issue so headline statements foot to the detail every time.

findings.finding: Aggregator receivables (GrubHub $12,762, UberEats, DoorDash) inside 'Credit Card Cash Receivables'; '6210 Promos' expense nested under Gross Retail Sales with a negative value.
findings.fix: Separate aggregator receivables and age them; move mis-nested contra accounts to their correct groups.

structural_moves.move: Add a revenue-center dimension (classes/locations: bar, dining, patio, stage, brewery/wholesale) so every report slices the way diligence expects.
Build a normalized-EBITDA schedule capturing add-backs as they occur — owner comp, related-party interest/rent, one-time costs.
Reconcile the cap table and simplify the equity section to match the operating agreement.
Enforce one menu taxonomy from Toast through to the GL, killing catch-all sales accounts.
Clean the suspense items — petty cash, negative AP, payroll clearing — so no unexplained balances remain.
